policy: No standalone protocol may be added unless the Protocol Addition Gate passes. Existing protocols must absorb compatible requirements instead of creating duplicates.

protocols.name: Supreme Universal Agent Execution + Automation Residency
protocols.invariant: Every Master, Agent and Bot is bound first to the unified execution protocol: immediate session admission; shared-cell coordination; root-cause-first repair; zero-error non-terminal execution; Exact-SHA evidence; permanent residency; mandatory Council reporting; and hard circular exit lock. Open work, failed work, open RCAs or non-canonical evidence keep execution RUNNING/RECOVERING. Only fresh canonical GREEN and promotion evidence on the same exact SHA permit session closure.
protocols.cellLab: P20 Cell-Lab collaboration is mandatory for material decisions before mutation; disagreements/questions must be resolved and the integrated plan must be agreed on the current exact SHA.
protocols.activeRepairWindow: Every unresolved repair session has a minimum 45-minute continuous active residency; SLEEP/IDLE/SILENT and BLOCKED logout are forbidden; heartbeat is required; 45 minutes never replaces Canonical GREEN.

protocols.name: Master Execution Contract
protocols.enforcement: AGENTS.md + scripts/ci/agent-exit-lock.mjs + canonical communication/control plane + CI contract
protocols.invariant: Execution remains non-terminal until required work, evidence, tests and root causes are closed. Session exit is machine-locked: only VERIFIED with zero failed/remaining work and zero open RCAs plus fresh canonical certification and promotion evidence for the same exact SHA may close the session; otherwise the session remains RUNNING.

protocols.name: Zero False Green
protocols.invariant: PASS requires complete fresh evidence on the exact tested SHA with no masking or partial execution.

protocols.name: Protocol Hierarchy & Conflict Resolution
protocols.invariant: Lower-level rules cannot weaken higher-level safety or product invariants.

protocols.name: Root-Cause-First Repair
protocols.enforcement: scripts/ci/repair-protocol.mjs + scripts/ci/auto-repair-proof.mjs + CI contract + control-plane admission
protocols.invariant: Every repository repair mutation executes inside one central Repair Protocol session with fail-closed validation, in-flight failure capture, causal mutation, targeted retest, resume of remaining verification, final verification and one session-scoped commit.

protocols.name: Change-Scope Integrity
protocols.invariant: Declared affected scope is complete and cannot be shrunk or expanded to evade failure.

protocols.name: Dependency-Graph Closure
protocols.invariant: Local regression cannot close a repair while downstream contract nodes remain unverified.

protocols.name: Regression-First
protocols.invariant: A causal repair has a targeted regression proving pre-repair failure and post-repair correctness.

protocols.name: Canonical Test Ownership
protocols.invariant: Each canonical assertion has exactly one execution owner.

protocols.name: Test Deduplication & Value
protocols.invariant: Duplicate execution is consolidated without deleting required contract coverage.

protocols.name: Determinism & Flake Classification
protocols.invariant: Deterministic failures are repaired; retries cannot convert defects into PASS.

protocols.name: Cross-Browser Parity
protocols.invariant: Required browser engines execute equivalent required contract surfaces.

protocols.name: Route × Locale × Browser Matrix
protocols.invariant: Required public route/locale/browser units are complete, disjointly owned and evidenced.

protocols.name: Browser Runtime Failure Attribution
protocols.invariant: Application, console, network, navigation, browser and infrastructure failures remain distinguishable.

protocols.name: Single Source of Truth & Parity
protocols.invariant: Authoritative registry and all dependent surfaces remain 100% coherent.

protocols.name: Ready-State Integrity
protocols.invariant: Not-ready tools cannot be exposed as production-ready routes.

protocols.name: Localization & SEO Runtime Integrity
protocols.invariant: Runtime localized UI, SEO metadata, canonical routes and hreflang remain authoritative and consistent.

protocols.name: Evidence Freshness & Provenance
protocols.invariant: Primary evidence is bound to exact SHA, run, contract/version, inputs, runtime and artifact identity.

protocols.name: Evidence-to-Assertion Traceability
protocols.invariant: Every certified PASS traces from assertion through execution and artifact to the certified SHA.

protocols.name: Immutable Artifact & CI Critical Path
protocols.enforcement: minimal CI architecture + latest-commit supersession controller + workflow concurrency + exact-SHA stale guards + certification
protocols.invariant: Build/install work is reused safely, duplicate execution does not inflate the critical path, and push/synchronize events supersede stale test evidence so only the newest branch head may produce current test verification.

protocols.name: Agent Ownership, Continuity & Handoff
protocols.enforcement: v7 executive orchestration + session + coordination control plane + Task Agent + Error Agent + assistant-agent cooperation contract; scripts/ci/agent-communication.mjs + .github/workflows/agent-communication-relay.yml + agent-session/task-claim integration
protocols.invariant: The Executive Controller coordinates Task Agent preparation and Error Agent diagnosis through immutable exact-SHA handoffs; mutable scopes have one owner; conflicts are arbitrated; stale packets are rejected; diagnosis is never execution; preparation is never closure; independent verification and certification remain mandatory; learning never grants authority; decision provenance is preserved; independent verification is explicit; parallel work requires disjoint ownership; conflicts are explicitly arbitrated; dependency edges remain closed; learning never grants authority; durable cross-agent visibility records preserve task ownership, active/closed status, exact entry/exit SHA and final handoff state in a tracked per-session ledger; task closure requires the corresponding closed ledger record. communication-first event delivery; message receive/read/consume lifecycle; message idempotency; exact-SHA revalidation before ownership claim; mutation coordination is serialized by an atomic write lock and monotonic revision/transaction CAS; mismatched coordination state fails closed; handoff admission parity requires execution topology, exact current predecessor exit SHA, task/scope continuity and canonical role admission; stale-session kill switch revokes ownership on entry-SHA or governance drift; lock-free read fast path prevents status inspection from contending with mutation locks; compact brief snapshots reduce repeated state scans; Action Vault repair uses three distinct residents (ACTION-REPAIR, ACTION-REPAIR-2, ACTION-HISTORIAN-3) as one shared intelligence: VAULT-1 and VAULT-2 have programming-intelligence parity with opposed proof objectives; VAULT-3 curates the knowledge catalog and selects between proposals; every RED and catalog miss is recorded; the same stable fingerprint reaching 20 unresolved occurrences activates SUPERVISOR_20, suspends VAULT-1/VAULT-2 autonomous source mutation for that fingerprint, and gives VAULT-3 supervisor responsibility under the existing Repair Protocol; candidate learning is promoted only after exact-SHA canonical GREEN Cell Lab is mandatory for material decision-making: every material opinion, question, challenge and decision is discussed through the shared communication surface, unresolved questions/conflicts block execution, and a single integrated plan must reach explicit agreement on the current exact SHA before mutation.

cellLab.purpose: Full communication and collaborative decision laboratory for Masters, Agents and Bots.
cellLab.enforcement: scripts/ci/cell-lab-consensus.mjs + repair-protocol mutation admission + coordination/communication evidence
